  "answer": "- Prefer remote when the local cache entry is missing or invalidated (TTL expiry, version mismatch, dependency update).
- Choose remote if the rubric signals higher authority, fresher source, or an explicit remote-first flag.
- Choose remote when the local endpoint latency or error rate exceeds acceptable thresholds.
- Select remote for mutable or rapidly changing data that cache invalidation cannot reliably serve.
- Favor remote when the remote endpoint holds authoritative state and the local cache could serve stale results.
- Recommendation: Route Strategy C to the remote endpoint whenever freshness, rubric priority, or invalidation status favors live data."
}
